product.title: Rome Walking Food Tour With Secret Food Tours

description.text: In Rome, get a taste of true Roman fare while exploring the city’s unique districts on this food walking tour. Follow your local guide—and your appetite—to authentic eateries in the Piazza Navona, Campo de' Fiori, and the Jewish Quarter. Stops include Piazza Navona, Campo de' Fiori, Jewish Quarter, Largo di Torre Argentina. Learn about Rome’s fascinating history while stopping to sample local specialties such as espresso, pizza, fried risotto balls called suppli, Roman pasta, cheeses, and artisinal gelato. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Piazza Navona, Campo de' Fiori, Jewish Quarter, Largo di Torre Argentina that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
